title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10718)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10718) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10718). This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) which is identical with ISO 3040: 1990 Technical drawings — Dimensioning and tolerancing — Cones', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the Engineering Division Council. The original version of this standard Method of dimensioning cones on technical drawings was based on ISO 3040 : 1974 Technical drawings — Dimensioning and tolerancing — Cones', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). Consequent to the revision of the ISO Standard, harmonization of the Indian Standard has been made by the adoption of ISO 3040 : 1990. The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are however not identical to those used in Indian Standards. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
